title: CreateParcelRequest (v1)
description: Body of POST /v1/partners/{partner}/parcels. Content-Type: application/json. Authentication: X-API-Key header. The (partner, ref) pair is the idempotency key: resending the same request is safe and returns the original parcel. v1 tolerates surrounding whitespace in ref/lockerId, the size aliases small/medium/large, and unknown fields (ignored); all three are deprecated and will be rejected in v2.

ref.description: Partner's own unique parcel reference; also the idempotency key. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed (deprecated).

lockerId.description: Target locker ID. Must exist and be online at creation time. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed (deprecated).

size.description: Compartment size. Canonical values S, M, L.

anyOf.description: Accepted in v1 for compatibility, normalised to S/M/L.
